name: TalentLMS
summary: TalentLMS is a cloud LMS with a free plan for up to 5 users and 10 courses, then published monthly prices of $119, $229 and $449 for Core, Grow and Pro. It delivers courses and SCORM content, assigns training through learning paths, and offers real-time, scheduled and custom reports.

facts.text: The Free plan has no time limit and covers up to 5 users and up to 10 courses.
The pricing page says yearly billing saves 20% compared with monthly billing.
The features page describes scheduled reports that can be emailed weekly or monthly, and custom reports filtered by user activity, learning progress or certifications.
The features page lists SCORM import, LTI 1.3, a REST API, Zapier and SSO among its integration options.
The security page lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance verified under the EU Cloud Code of Conduct.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users and 10 courses, no time limit, 100MB upload limit per file

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Monthly price shown for the smallest user band; the pricing page offers larger bands up to 1,000 users and its band selector is unclear about which prices apply to them. One branch

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Three branches and five learning paths. Monthly price shown for the smallest user band

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Plus $6 per additional user. Fifteen branches and unlimited learning paths

hiddenCosts: Bundles with TalentHR and TalentCards are priced on request.
TalentLibrary is an add-on available with all plans and its fee is not shown on the pricing page.
